sample.label: expose-vs-conceal
sample.rationale: Latent Error's whole discipline is making structural failure visible ("redesign so failure requires more than one simultaneous mistake"). Compressor Design's own link names Trickster's soft-knee move as hiding the discontinuity it's smoothing over. Same design surface, opposite instinct — worth sharpening from a flat connects-to into a named tension rather than replacing it outright; offered for Concierge judgment, not a forced overwrite.
sample.evidence: Latent Error.md:37 "don't design for idealized attention, redesign so failure requires more than one simultaneous mistake" — Compressor Design.md:25-27 target Trickster label "soft-knee-hides-discontinuity"

sample.label: iterated-by-ear

sample.evidence: "the instrument was then iterated by ear across eight audio renders" (Bayesian Granular Synthesizer.md:39); "Wire the optional grain-entrainment coupling and audition whether population-locking adds to the condensation or muddies it." (:75)

sample.label: reflection-in-sound
sample.rationale: Both newcomers, both under-reached (Audition Gate 0 inbound, Reflective Practice 1 inbound). Audition Gate is a sound-domain instance of exactly the Schön reflection pattern Reflective Practice names: the spec is suspended and perception takes over. Neither entry currently knows the other exists.
sample.evidence: Audition Gate: "The audition is non-negotiable. It is not a review of the spec; it is a check that the spec's intent landed in the audio." (Audition Gate.md:34) — Reflective Practice: "The situation talks back, the practitioner listens, and as he appreciates what he hears, he reframes the situation once again." (Reflective Practice.md:47-49)
